inline.body:
❓ **QUESTION**: The removed legacy branch handled the `unavailable` response — is that covered on the SDK path?

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

The deleted code checked `response.unavailable`, deleted the cipher from local state, and returned `undefined`:

```ts
if (response.unavailable) {
  await this.delete(cipher.id, userId);
  return;
}
```

Two things still reference that contract:

- `libs/vault/src/cipher-form/services/default-cipher-form.service.ts:106-112` special-cases `savedCipher == null` with the comment "Its possible the cipher was made no longer available due to collection assignment changes". With the legacy branch gone, `saveCollectionsWithServer` always returns `encryptResult.cipher`, so that branch looks unreachable.
- `CipherSdkServiceAbstraction.saveCollectionsWithServer` (`libs/common/src/vault/abstractions/cipher-sdk.service.ts:154`) is documented as returning "the updated cipher view, or undefined if unavailable". If it can return `undefined`, that value is passed straight into `cipherEncryptionService.encrypt` here.

If the SDK handles the access-loss case internally (including removing the item from local state), the stale JSDoc and the now-dead `null` check downstream are worth cleaning up. If it does not, losing access after a collection reassignment would leave the item in local state.
</details>

♻️ **DEBT**: This flag removal orphans the legacy collection/move API surface.

<details>
<summary>Now-unreferenced code</summary>

With the last callers gone, these have no remaining references in the repo:

- `CipherBulkUpdateCollectionsRequest` — no references outside its own definition file
- `ApiService.putMoveCiphers`, `putCipherCollections`, `putCipherCollectionsAdmin` (abstraction + implementation) — only remaining mentions are `not.toHaveBeenCalled()` assertions in `cipher.service.spec.ts`
- `CipherCollectionsRequest` and `CipherBulkMoveRequest`, which exist only to feed those three methods

Removing them here (or in a tracked follow-up) keeps the flag cleanup complete.
</details>

comments.body:
## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

This PR removes the `PM28191CipherAdminOpsToSdk` feature flag and its legacy non-SDK branches from `CipherService`, leaving the SDK path as the only implementation for `getManyFromApiForOrganization`, `saveCollectionsWithServer`, `saveCollectionsWithServerAdmin`, `bulkUpdateCollectionsWithServer`, and `moveManyWithServer`. The flag is fully removed from both `FeatureFlag` and `DefaultFeatureFlagValue`, and a repo-wide search found no remaining references to it or its string value. Test changes track the code changes correctly: the disabled-path tests are deleted and the enabled-path tests are retained with the flag setup stripped. Two non-blocking items are noted inline.

<details>
<summary>Code Review Details</summary>

- ♻️ : Flag removal orphans the legacy collection/move API surface (`CipherBulkUpdateCollectionsRequest`, three `ApiService` methods, two request models)
  - `libs/common/src/vault/services/cipher.service.ts:1180`
- ❓ : Removed legacy branch handled the `unavailable` response by deleting the local cipher; downstream `savedCipher == null` check appears stranded
  - `libs/common/src/vault/services/cipher.service.ts:1142`

</details>
